mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS principal_id,u.version AS principal_version,t.version AS tenant_version, m.id AS membership_id,m.generation,m.version AS membership_version, d.capabilities_json,d.max_duration_seconds,a.manifest_version,s.content_hash,s.manifest_json, COALESCE(mp.presentation_json,'[]') AS presentation_json,mp.presentation_hash, COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('capability',cs.capability,'disabled',cs.disabled,'version',cs.version) ORDER BY cs.capability)::text FROM auth_governance.capability_state cs WHERE cs.application_id=a.application_id AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.manifest_json::jsonb->'capabilities') c WHERE c->>'code'=cs.capability) ),'[]') AS capability_states_json FROM auth_governance.login_identity li JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=li.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.principal_id=u.id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=m.tenant_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant_application ta ON ta.tenant_id=m.tenant_id JOIN auth_governance.access_delegation d ON d.tenant_id=ta.tenant_id AND d.application_id=ta.application_id AND d.environment=ta.environment AND d.membership_id=m.id AND d.generation=m.generation JOIN auth_governance.application_catalog a ON a.application_id=ta.application_id JOIN auth_governance.application_manifest s ON s.application_id=a.application_id AND s.version=a.manifest_version LEFT JOIN auth_governance.application_manifest_presentation mp ON mp.application_id=s.application_id AND mp.version=s.version WHERE li.issuer=#{issuer} AND li.subject=#{subject} AND ta.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND ta.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND ta.environment=#{p.environment} AND ta.enabled AND d.enabled AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <= clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > clock_timestamp()) AND a.manifest_version>0

SELECT a.application_id,a.environment,(d.membership_id IS NOT NULL) management FROM auth_governance.tenant_application a JOIN auth_governance.application_catalog c ON c.application_id=a.application_id AND c.manifest_version > 0 LEFT JOIN auth_governance.access_delegation d ON d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.application_id=a.application_id AND d.environment=a.environment AND d.membership_id=#{member} AND d.generation=#{generation} AND d.enabled WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.enabled AND (a.application_id,a.environment) > (#{application},#{environment}) AND (d.membership_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.access_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND g.application_id=a.application_id AND g.environment=a.environment AND ((g.membership_id=#{member} AND g.generation=#{generation}) OR (g.source_type='GROUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.directory_group_member gm WHERE gm.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.membership_id=#{member} AND gm.generation=#{generation} AND gm.current))))) ORDER BY a.application_id,a.environment LIMIT 21

SELECT m.id membership_id,m.generation,m.member_kind,m.valid_to::text FROM auth_governance.membership m JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.id > #{after} AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 101
SELECT capability FROM auth_governance.capability_state WHERE application_id=#{application} AND disabled ORDER BY capability LIMIT 201

SELECT id,tenant_id,application_id,environment,role_code,version,capabilities_json,content_hash FROM auth_governance.role_version WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND environment=#{p.environment} AND role_code=#{code} AND version < #{version} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM auth_governance.access_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND environment=#{p.environment} AND role_id=#{role}

SELECT id,tenant_id,application_id,environment,role_id,scope_json,max_duration_seconds,approver_membership_id,approver_generation,delegation_hash,policy_version,content_hash,enabled FROM auth_governance.request_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND environment=#{p.environment} AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 101
